hero.label: Why now
hero.title: Ward 6 has had the same alderman since 1985.
hero.sub: That is not an attack. It is a fact, and it is why this race matters.

timeline.label: Then and now
timeline.title: A lot can change in 41 years
timeline.intro: Michael B. Saville has served Ward 6 since 1985, and we thank him for his service. The world around Ward 6 has changed a great deal since then. Here is a short look.
timeline.i1_text: In May 1985, the current alderman is appointed to represent Ward 6.
timeline.i2_text: The current alderman starts the Riverwalk Commission.
timeline.i3_text: Smartphones become part of daily life, and the Great Recession reshapes family budgets across the country.
timeline.i4_text: Schools, shops, and neighborhood gathering places close for a time, and neighbors lean on each other.
timeline.i5_text: The challenges look different than they did in 1985. Ward 6 deserves someone ready to meet them with fresh eyes and new ideas.
timeline.i6_text: The primary on February 23, 2027 is the first vote and narrows the field. The general election on April 6, 2027 decides who represents Ward 6 next.

fresh.label: What fresh means
fresh.title: New representation, in practice
fresh.intro: Less about the past. More about what Cassandra will do.
fresh.c1_old: One familiar point of view at the table.
fresh.c1_new: Cassandra will make listening the first job, with open neighborhood meetings and real answers to residents' questions.
fresh.c2_old: The same approach, year after year.
fresh.c2_new: Cassandra brings practical, community-centered ideas for safer streets, dignity for unhoused neighbors, and investment in our youth.
fresh.c3_new: Cassandra will knock on doors, show up at neighborhood events, and be present in every corner of Ward 6.
fresh.c4_old: The same seat, election after election.
fresh.c4_new: Cassandra will report back regularly on what she is doing and why, and measure success by results for neighbors.

cta.title: Ward 6 deserves a choice
cta.text: Neighbors make change happen. Give an hour, share a story, or chip in, and help build hope in Ward 6.
